title: Python Playground
description: A responsive browser playground for Python 3.10 and JavaScript with editable test cases, autosave, and submission history.

brief.summary: A browser playground for Python 3.10 and JavaScript with editable test cases, autosave, and submission history.

sections.heading: Browser-side execution
sections.body: Python 3.10 runs through Pyodide in a Web Worker. JavaScript runs in a sandboxed iframe, and each test case gets its own run.

sections.heading: Test cases
sections.body: Run executes the selected test case; Submit executes every test case. Output comparison preserves spaces, tabs, commas, and punctuation, normalizes CRLF/CR line endings to LF, and ignores one final newline.

sections.heading: Saved work
sections.body: Code and test cases autosave after a 700 ms pause and are restored later. The 50 most recent submissions are kept newest first.

brief.note: The description, sample code, and test case come from the supplied playground README and its default configuration.

tests.note: This test case is supplied by the playground's default configuration. The program reads one line and prints it back.

instructions: Open the workspace; the supplied default program is already in the editor.
Run the default test case to execute the code with Hello World as input and see the real browser output.
Edit the code or the test case to explore other values. Edits autosave for this project in this browser.
Use the Back link to return to the project shelf.

preview.description: Runs the supplied default program with the default test case and shows the real browser output.
